title: NIST Is Turning Scientific Waste Into Cancer-Fighting Material
sourceName: National Institute of Standards and Technology
content: Manny Mejias is the radiation safety officer (RSO) and chief of the Radiation Safety Division at NIST. He is responsible for ensuring the safety and compliance of ionizing radiation programs and Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) licenses across the agency's Gaithersburg and Boulder campuses. Manny is passionate about reducing legacy waste and safely repurposing materials that retain scientific value. His foundation in health physics includes an A.S. in nuclear engineering technology, National Registry of Radiation Protection Technologists certification, and serving as a Nuclear Technical Advisory Group member. Outside of his professional duties, he can often be found playing chess or billiards.
